title: The Pink Witch Halloween Costume
intro: The witch costume, minus the green face paint and the cape you trip over. A black velvet mini does the heavy lifting, the pink velvet hat and lace gloves make it read as a costume, and every piece except the hat goes straight back into your closet for holiday parties.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay on white linen of a pink velvet witch hat, black velvet mini dress, pink lace gloves, black platform Mary Janes, gold moon earrings and a black crescent bag.
Mirror selfie in a farmhouse hallway of a woman in a black velvet mini dress, pink velvet witch hat, pink lace gloves and black Mary Janes, holding a pink tumbler.
